title: Baha
setup: Tatlong araw ng ulan at bumaha ang bayan. Ang proyektong 'tapos na' tatlong taon na ang nakalipas — wala. Ang arko, maganda. Nagkukumpol ang mga tao sa barangay hall, basang-basa at galit.
setup_en: Three days of rain and the town floods. The project that was 'finished' three years ago — doesn't exist. The arch is lovely. People gather at the barangay hall, soaked and angry.

success.text: Tumahimik ang lahat. Ikaw ang unang boses. May sumunod.
success.text_en: The room goes quiet. You are the first voice. Someone follows.

fail.text: Umay ka muna, pero nagsalita ka. Ikaw ang unang boses.
fail.text_en: It comes out rough, but you spoke. You are the first voice.

choices.label: Maghihintay ako kung sino ang magsasalita.
choices.label_en: I'll wait to see who speaks.

choices.label: Dadalhin ko ang mga kapitbahay ko.

success.text: Dumating ang mga kapitbahay. Dalawang boses pa.
success.text_en: The neighbors arrive. Two more voices.

fail.text: Isang kapitbahay ang sumama. Boses pa rin.
fail.text_en: One neighbor joins. A voice anyway.

callback: Voice count begins. Echoes add voices.
